independentRecomputation.readonlyChecks: All four actual requests set executor want balance to zero, sold to 103 and native to 17. Actual calldata uses the readonly subprogram mode and checks its returned output against the independent same-N quote. All expected observed token/account rows and executor native delta are zero; logs are empty.
independentRecomputation.negativeChecks: All eight transport results are ok=true with completion=reverted-as-declared. Zero-input cases carry Panic(0x11); forced post-execution cases carry runtime amount mismatch. Post-revert calldata is the corresponding successful program plus the intentional false equality guard. All returned effect arrays are empty; this is not a complete stateDiff rollback proof.
